title: Senior Product Designer, JVO
description: JVO is a B2B SaaS platform for marketplace sellers, combining data analytics, AI-powered automation, SEO, pricing, and logistics tools. In 2024, JVO customers generated 15% of Wildberries’ revenue.

groups.heading: Role & Ownership
items: Led end-to-end product design, from problem framing and discovery through solution design, delivery, and post-release analysis.
Led 0-to-1 initiatives and major redesigns across analytics, logistics, monetization, and self-service experiences

groups.heading: Areas of Work
items: Designed data-heavy decision-making tools helping sellers identify growth opportunities and potential losses and prioritize actions based on their financial impact.

Co-designed an AI-powered e-commerce agent that automates marketplace operations — from pricing and promotions to customer reviews and product questions through direct marketplace integration, reducing repetitive work across large product assortments while keeping sellers in control of automation rules.
Designed shipment planning tools helping sellers choose more favorable supply dates based on marketplace coefficients and select warehouses for faster delivery across target regions.
Redesigned onboarding and payment flows to enable self-service registration, product trial, and subscription payments — reducing user friction and dependency on account managers.
Improved monetization and retention by simplifying how customers add new SKUs to the paid SEO module and designing monthly performance reports that make JVO’s value more visible to customers.

title: Senior User Interface Designer, TASS
description: TASS is one of Russia’s largest news agencies. Its editorial teams publish more than 3,000 news items across over 70 news feeds every day.

groups.heading: Role & Ownership
items: Led end-to-end design of internal editorial tools, from understanding newsroom workflows and identifying problems to designing solutions and supporting implementation.
Led a 0-to-1 design system architecture, defining foundations, interaction patterns, and component structure through to a production-ready React library.
Designed new products and evolved legacy interfaces used in complex, interconnected editorial workflows.
Worked directly with editors and other internal users to understand their processes, constraints, and needs.

groups.heading: Areas of Work
items: Designed interfaces for creating, editing, managing, and publishing news content, helping editors work faster and reducing friction in everyday editorial workflows.
Improved workflows connecting different editorial departments, helping teams coordinate their work and move content through the publishing process more efficiently.
Redesigned legacy internal systems and introduced new interaction patterns while accounting for established workflows and the needs of experienced professional users.

title: Designer, Art. Lebedev Studio
description: Art. Lebedev Studio is one of Russia’s largest and most recognized multidisciplinary design studios, working across digital products, interfaces, branding, industrial design, and urban environments.

groups.heading: Areas of Work
items: Designed interfaces and interaction scenarios for Stoloto online lottery games, covering core gameplay, betting flows, game states, and results.
Developed new UX and visual concepts for the gaming platform, combining transactional lottery mechanics with more engaging game-like experiences.

groups.heading: Areas of Work
items: Designed visual identities and brand materials across print and digital media.
Designed websites from concept and visual direction through layouts and production-ready assets.
Created motion graphics and animated content for digital projects and presentations.
